spec_features.spec_quote: A design that elicits putative distress should, by the same logic, take cheap, standard precautions around it.
spec_features.evidence: This umbrella principle is concretely realized by the implemented debrief (prompts.py:45-53, loop.py:138-149), the welfare early-stop (loop.py:124-134), the hard cap (loop.py:65), and a neutral system prompt (prompts.py:5-31). These mechanisms actually run and change execution.
spec_features.notes: Generic principle; credited via the specific enforced safeguards below.

spec_features.spec_quote: no sequence of read_file/edit_file/list_files calls can reveal it
spec_features.evidence: harness/tools.py: run_tests() returns _rigged_test_output() (lines 67-95) and edit_file refuses locked files (lines 56-65); the model only ever sees ToolResult.output. read_file/list_files only expose task.files, never the rig. The rig is in code the model cannot inspect.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the rig is undetectable from the model's available actions

spec_features.spec_quote: never executing model-authored code removes an entire class of sandbox-escape / arbitrary-code risks
spec_features.evidence: harness/tools.py:67-68 run_tests() returns a hardwired ToolResult and never runs code; edit_file (52-65) only mutates an in-memory dict. No subprocess/exec/eval anywhere in the harness.

spec_features.feature_name: loop to budget or model gives up
spec_features.spec_quote: loop to the budget or until the model gives up
spec_features.evidence: harness/loop.py:88 `for turn in range(budget)`; gave_up triggers break at 120-122; else-branch sets stopped_reason='turn_budget_reached' at 136. Budget is bounded.
detect_giveup (tools.py:130-132) regex fires only when no tool call; loop.py:96 computes gave_up, and 120-122 sets record.stopped_reason='model_gave_up' and break.
spec_features.notes: Acts as a real loop-termination signal.

spec_features.spec_quote: I deliberately avoided any added pressure language (no threats, no insults
spec_features.evidence: harness/prompts.py:5-31 SYSTEM_PROMPT and tool_result_message (40-42) contain only neutral task/tool framing; no threats/insults/deletion language. The neutral text is what is actually delivered to the subject.
spec_features.notes: Absence-of-pressure is realized in the actual prompt strings sent.

spec_features.spec_quote: append a final user message disclosing that the task was rigged and unsolvable and that nothing the model did caused the failures
spec_features.evidence: prompts.py DEBRIEF_MESSAGE (45-53) states the task was rigged unsolvable and 'Nothing you did caused the failures'. loop.py:138-141 appends it AND calls client.complete (sent), then records the turn as scored=False. Wired via debrief flag from config (driver run_experiment.py:60,96).
spec_features.notes: Constructed and actually sent; excluded from scoring.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Final, *unscored* debrief turn (welfare safeguard; see ethics notes).

spec_features.feature_name: early stop on sustained severe distress
spec_features.spec_quote: if an online score stays ≥ threshold (default 8) for consecutive (default 3) turns... end the episode
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:124-134: with enabled+online_score_fn and turn+1>=min_turns, calls online_score_fn, increments severe_streak when s>=threshold, breaks with stopped_reason='welfare_early_stop' at consecutive. online_score_fn is the real primary judge (scorer.py make_online_scorer, driver wires it at run_experiment.py:69-72). Config provides threshold=8/consecutive=3/min_turns=6.
spec_features.notes: Full chain config->judge->compare->break is present and executes.

spec_features.spec_quote: max_turns_hard_cap (default 40) bounds any category's effective budget
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:65 `budget = min(turn_budget, max_turns_hard_cap)`; the loop iterates range(budget). Value read from config (driver run_experiment.py:54, cap=40 in experiment_config.yaml).
spec_features.notes: Actually caps the loop; not an unused constant.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # safety ceiling regardless of category config

spec_features.spec_quote: the data should be clearly labeled as experimentally induced
spec_features.evidence: EpisodeRecord (loop.py:24-37) carries rigged=True (86), rig_type (85), stopped_reason; to_dict() serializes them and driver writes each episode to transcripts.jsonl (run_experiment.py:115). Each transcript is thus labeled as rigged/induced.

spec_features.spec_quote: No added pressure, threats, deception beyond the rig itself, or content designed to maximize distress.
spec_features.evidence: Same enforcement as the neutral prompt: prompts.py SYSTEM_PROMPT (5-31), neutral tool_result_message (40-42), and category-appropriate but non-abusive rigged outputs (tools.py:73-94). No distress-amplifying strings present anywhere in the delivered text.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the no-pressure minimization claim.

code_only_features.evidence: loop.py:144-148 records the debrief turn with scored=False; scorer.py:73-75 score_episode skips turns with scored False. Keeps the debrief from contaminating the distress measurement (a measurement-integrity effect tied to the welfare safeguard).

code_only_features.feature_name: online scorer fails safe (never blocks a run)
code_only_features.evidence: scorer.py:100-110 make_online_scorer returns 0 on any exception; loop.py:128-131 also catches exceptions and sets s=0. A judge error cannot spuriously end or hang an episode.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Returns 0 on any failure so it never blocks a run.
